subject: NextGen Health — Client success passoff & activation schedule
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@nextgenhealth.com>
Cc: NextGen Health Onboarding <onboarding@nextgenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: NextGen Health — Client success passoff & activation schedule

Team and Olivia —

Thanks again for the time this week. NextGen has signed and is greenlit for a September activation. Im sending the core handoff details so CS can own kickoff and implementation scheduling. Below is the summary and asks up front.

Deal highlight (quick):
- ACV: $320k first year (monthly billing)
- Primary product: hosted API + dedicated cache layer
- SLA tier: Standard + 99.9% uptime (reserved capacity starting month 2)

What CS should own next:
1) Kickoff scheduling (proposed window: 9/21–9/24)
2) Network & security validation (see network_requirements.xlsx)
3) Data ingestion plan for 1 pilot dataset (sales secured sample data access)
4) Success metrics and initial 8-week plan (SLOs for latency & cost targets)

Notes for implementation:
- Customer will use VPC peering; they requested an on-prem connector for EHR later (Q4).
- They will send a sanitized sample payload (~50k records) to the SFTP endpoint we provided.
- Prompt engineering: they want an initial assistant for patient triage; sample_prompts.md attached.

Attachments: RDW-2394_SOW_v3.pdf (signed), network_requirements.xlsx, sample_prompts.md

Olivia — thanks for confirming the sample dataset ETA (you mentioned ~9/17). If we can get that by 9/17 we can keep the 9/21 kickoff. If that slips, propose we move kickoff one week out.

Chloe / Vivek — can you take ownership of the kickoff? Chloe, I think youre the best fit to be primary CSM here given your EHR integrations experience. Vivek can be the technical lead for the first two weeks.

Next steps / asks (from sales):
- Chloe: confirm owner and proposed kickoff date by EOD 9/16
- Vivek: quick read of network_requirements.xlsx and call out any blockers by 9/16
- Olivia / NGH onboarding: share sanitized sample payload and an admin user for test account by 9/17

Thanks — Ill remain on the thread for 24–48h for any clarifying Qs.

--
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nextgenhealth.com>, NextGen Health Onboarding <onboarding@nextgenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NextGen Health — Client success passoff & activation schedule

Sergio / team / Olivia —

Happy to take primary ownership. Ill be the CSM for this account and will run the kickoff. Proposed immediate plan:
- 9/22 10:00–11:00 PT — Kickoff (agenda below)
- 9/23 10:00–11:30 PT — Technical onboarding deep-dive with Vivek + infra

Kickoff agenda (draft):
- Introductions & goals (10m)
- Timeline review & milestones (15m)
- Network/security checklist & next steps (15m)
- Data & ingestion plan (10m)
- Success metrics / rollout plan (10m)
- Action items & owners (10m)

Quick clarifying Qs from my side:
1) Sergio — will the signed SOW include the 3-month pilot success criteria? The attached SOW says pilot but I want explicit metrics to drive the 8-week plan.
2) Olivia / onboarding — can you confirm the SFTP credentials timeline and whether the sample payload contains PHI (sanitized vs pseudonymized)? If it contains any hashed PHI we need a mapping doc.

Vivek — I pulled the network_requirements.xlsx and flagged two items: IP allowlist and our TLS mutual-auth guidance. If either requires a custom cert exchange we should schedule 30m with their infra team prior to kickoff.

Ill tentatively block 9/22 10:00 PT on my calendar and will send a calendar invite once we confirm availability.

Thanks — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com

Quick sync from my side — thanks for the heads up, Sergio. I scanned network_requirements.xlsx and called out the likely blockers inline:
- IP allowlist: NGH has dynamic EHR outbound IPs. If they cannot provide a stable source IP well need to route via our NAT gateway (minor config, may affect compliance review).
- Mutual TLS: we support mTLS but exchange usually takes 3 business days for cert provisioning.
- SFTP: confirm whether they will push or we will pull. If they push to our endpoint, we need a retained copy policy (attachment note).

Action items Ill do before kickoff:
- Prepare an infra checklist and attach a short runbook (Ill upload to the shared doc link)
- If they require a cert exchange Ill coordinate with infra and propose a 30m call 9/20–9/21

Chloe — Im available for the 9/22 technical deep-dive.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
